dataset: FlyEM MaleCNS v1.0, min confidence 0.5, traced-only edges
selection: all descending neurons; top P1 presynaptic partners by contact weight onto DNs (cap 4000); top P2 second-hop by contact weight onto P1 (cap 8000); all measured internal directed edges retained; ties by bodyId. No game outcomes used.
assumptions: Engineered 13-channel obs-to-cell-type mapping; signed leaky-tanh rate dynamics; ACh +1, GABA/Glu/histamine -1, DA/5HT/OA +1 (Shiu convention), unknown/predicted fallback else 0. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.
